launches.body:
### **Tl;dr**

We make it easy for sales reps to reach many more **qualified** **prospects**, without sacrificing **hyper-personalization**. A prospecting bot conducts prospect research on aspects sales reps care about and personalizes emails in the way they need. 

Hey everyone! We are Shen and Hankel aka the team behind Coldreach.

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/MjyaZpGvltrsSs0ixus0dl1Yj4Kp6crAFBOh45wmdj941cuhaMYAck8PMAbQqtVXNhHIo-1JpJtSMmII4dvrqsCH8l4_tlLzye-qwKdrF1HhonZ1RNCvshyOtxmYuHMUrNxfu6sSDJ4XZHubmrL6kJg)

### **👪 Who is it for**

Are your sales reps:

\- spending a lot of time on **prospect research** and **personalizing emails** 

OR 

\- not spending enough time on that? 

Then Coldreach is for your team. 

### **🧨 The Problem**

Sales reps face a dilemma today: **quality vs. quantity**. 

Take our friend Sam as an example. He is an SDR at a B2B company. He researches prospects thoroughly and personalizes every message. As a result, he gets a great reply rate, but he spends so much time on every prospect that he couldn’t reach out to a lot of people. To generate more pipelines, Sam tries to “spray and pray” a little bit - he created a sequence of templated emails and added 300 leads onto it, but got zero conversion. 

Reps like Sam are forced to find a **balance between quantity and quality**, which often distinguishes the best-performing reps from the rest. 

### **💡 Our solution**

We automate prospect research and email personalization, allowing sales reps to have the best of both worlds and reach many more prospects with hyper-personalization. 

No one knows better than your sales team how to prospect effectively, and certainly not an AI. So we allow you to **customize your own prospecting bot**:

Specify what you’re looking for in prospects or accounts.

![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/NkZhfTa8P0rYV-iogDy5FIJJQdIcMGp-wUusr1lL8QkXmmnG7gU6DW1j0g2u89px2USJMkZ6ZAhUhuU7oW9yZvWZ1YCI9mXTxZZscFRKyoTTurSLgxPawPC9BQ5MovBcahANSae9Xzd1I1z_t2gN3f0)

Our AI answers your questions based on real-time data from different sources. 

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/IT1A9FDcMDNJNqMaEI0JzyBr0RAm25mI6yMFjnRn2NBpbWKSDEOoLB_FViN3ZcwM0JuuFBjeTIeyzcCM9z3Izq6IL2wTrY6HuhdM1Qp_0u4kXpdrFeKZnZWmtxxy0v13er_GG0YvXjDF3Z_GvEt5TyM)

Import your prospect list, research prospects and quickly qualify/disqualify. 

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/ORhMQ6kPxSM8DznlwDez-y1vHz4DzH1WrV-kuup7RusjHUDFlhtvFmzdS4-ND9W2QMmuOC3ZYQ9744ltrwDeBC8NkE5nbEPKQDMGNx7hVnvLdbe_FmvIUQvI2nyQ0Ct0fz8jgVID912S8IqA-qZ9tXk)

Easily customize how you want your emails to be personalized. In one click, generate hundreds of personalized emails based on research and start your sequence. 

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/DRGM8Z19PxQZ7KqfBfsR3hTbl1MMb4YFMJMz2hYMl2v0AkYQ21iRDJyuXSjXkEEgzgkd3egUrkg8a3nIoZbYsvhscu-E3cB8dQO1LIcfZzmOjon0Cj64-VPujirI2MK8AXKId82vvbbztdskt2uEFm4)

launches.title: Hindsight – Competitive Intelligence That’s Actually Intelligent
launches.tagline: Win more competitive deals with simple AI-powered insights and workflows
launches.body:
Deals are more competitive than ever, and sales teams don’t feel prepared to win. Product marketing teams constantly get hit with questions like:

* “How do we beat \[competitor\]?”
* “Do we have a battlecard for this?”
* “What’s our answer to \[new competitor launch\]?”

To find answers, teams have to dig through call recordings, piece together competitor research, and hope they’re making the right call.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88481&key=user_uploads/1213493/b87ca67c-de33-4a14-9dfa-28abc23ce023)

### **The Problem**

Competitive intelligence today is **broken**:

* **Prioritizing junk data** – Teams spend tons of money on web monitoring tools that flood them with alerts that don't actually matter.
* **Ignoring the best source of intelligence—actual buyers** – Most marketing teams review **<5%** of calls and talk to **<1%** of lost prospects. That’s not enough to know why deals are really won or lost.
* **Outdated content** – PMMs spend weeks building battlecards that go stale before they’re used. Sales stops trusting them, and adoption plummets.

### **How Hindsight Fixes This**

<https://youtu.be/vqNqL9ZylVU>

Unlike other CI tools, Hindsight prioritizes competitive insights directly from your buyers AND helps you collect it.

* **Win-Loss at Scale** – AI analyzes 100% of your CRM deals, calls, and emails to uncover decision drivers, identify competitors, and clip key quotes from deals.
* **Automated Buyer Feedback** – Hindsight runs unbiased debriefs with won and lost prospects to uncover how they really compare you vs. competitors—giving you the data sales teams actually need.
* **Real-Time Competitive Intelligence** – Hindsight monitors the web and your other sales tools daily to build and maintain battlecards automatically.
* **Just-in-Time Sales Enablement** – Insights and battlecards are delivered directly in Slack or email so reps always have the right info before their calls. Automatically updated as new insights roll in.
* And a lot more!

### **Why We’re Building Hindsight**

Hey, I’m Ani 👋. I co-founded Hindsight with one of my best friends, Andrew Luo. When I was a PM, I spent too much time **guessing** why we won or lost deals. Our roadmap was shaped by opinions instead of facts, and I struggled to get sales teams aligned with the right messaging.

We built Hindsight to turn every deal into a learning opportunity and make sure sales, product, and marketing are always aligned on the truth.

### **See Hindsight in Action**

Hindsight integrates seamlessly with **Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack and other popular tools**, so you can capture and act on the right insights instantly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88481&key=user_uploads/1213493/be5da5a9-7e57-46d3-b273-13557e270c68)

Teams using Hindsight see competitive win rates increase by up to **15%**.

If you’re in a competitive industry and want to stop losing winnable deals

launches.title: Gerri 2.0 - The AI Agent for Contracts from Common Paper
launches.tagline: Put your redlines on autopilot
launches.body:
Most AI contract tools are built to support a single lawyer working within Word. [Gerri is built for everyone with a stake in getting a deal signed.](https://www.getgerri.ai/) 

2 minute intro:[ youtube.com/watch?v=QL4nIETkZnY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL4nIETkZnY) 

3 minute demo:[ loom.com/share/ac7906243ce340159797af888488cb6b](https://www.loom.com/share/ac7906243ce340159797af888488cb6b)

**Background:**

More than 10,000 companies have used Common Paper to close deals over the past few years. While the standards have helped, we keep hearing how painful the redline process is. The root cause is that contract negotiation is a team sport, but most tools are built for one player.

Most teams end up in one of two camps:

* Every redline goes to the attorney, which is expensive and slows deals down
* Redlines get triaged first, usually by someone in sales or ops, and contracts are one of 10 things they have on their plate

What's missing is a system where AI does the first read, loops in the right people when needed, and pulls all of their feedback into a new draft that can be sent back to the other side. 

That's Gerri.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99518&key=user_uploads/71220/c7e0519b-5c7b-46d2-8456-3ecbb0a4b5b4)


**How it works:**

Contracts get into Gerri three ways: upload, forwarded email, or direct inbox scanning. From there:

* Gerri reads every redline against your playbook and automatically accepts, rejects, or counterproposes anything it can handle
* Anything outside the playbook gets routed to the right person. That might be legal for indemnity questions, finance for payment terms, VP of Sales for commercial terms, etc.
* Every AI decision cites the specific playbook rule behind it; every human override is logged
* Gerri edits the Word doc directly and can add comments in your name, explaining the reasoning to the other side

Gerri typically reviews contracts before you even know they've arrived. You'll open your inbox, see a contract, and find it's already been handled.

**What's new in 2.0:**

* 10X faster processing engine. 90% of contracts reviewed in under 3 minutes.
* Any contract type: your paper, their paper, standard or custom agreements
* Personality Settings: set custom instructions that guide Gerri's behavior across all contracts, without editing individual playbook rules
* Template Improvement: Gerri analyzes your negotiation history and suggests changes to your outgoing templates that proactively reduce future redlines. The more you use it, the smarter your paper gets.
* Optional attorney review add-on: flat fee, 4-hour turnaround guarantee, for when you need a human in the loop
* Available as a standalone product at [getgerri.ai](http://getgerri.ai)  - No other Common Paper subscription required

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99518&key=user_uploads/71220/304536b5-ce30-400e-8036-e43eb4c63ce3)

Try it free at [getgerri.ai](http://getgerri.ai)

launches.title: Gerri - The AI Agent for Contract Redlines
launches.tagline: Get your contracts reviewed before you even realize they’re in your inbox
launches.body:
We’re Jake and Ben, co-founders of Common Paper.  We just launched Gerri, the AI agent for redlines. [Try it out here and get three contracts reviewed for free](https://commonpaper.com/product/ai-agent).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL4nIETkZnY

## Problem

Common Paper started by creating [standard agreements](https://commonpaper.com/standards/) that have been signed by more than 10,000 companies and used to close more than $100 million dollars in deals. We also make contract management software for customizing, signing, and tracking agreements with customers and partners.

As companies scale, more and more of their sales teams’ time is spent dealing with contract redlines from their customers.  After talking seeing the problem close up at countless companies, we found that most folks fall into one of two camps:

* Every contract redline gets sent to their attorney, which is expensive and adds delays
* Nothing gets sent to the attorney, and the founder, sales, ops, or other non-lawyer handles all redlines. This creates a significant risk when they don’t know what they don’t know about risks in contracts

A better approach is to have AI do a first read of each contract and then triage the redlines so that as much as possible is handled automatically, and then if anything remains, assign it to the right person. That’s what we built with Gerri.

## Solution

There are three ways contracts get into Gerri:

* Upload
* Forward an email with attachment
* Have Gerri scan your team’s inboxes for redlined contracts and automatically review them as they come in

Once Gerri gets a contract, it compares it to your playbook, which contains rules about what you will and won’t accept, how you respond to asks, comments to leave in the doc, etc. Gerri includes a demo playbook to help you get started, and you can chat or answer questions to have Gerri help you generate your own custom rules.

Gerri then either

* Responds with a clean contract that’s ready to send back to the other side.  Gerri automatically accepts, rejects, counter-proposes, and leaves comments for the other side.  
* Flags which redlines can’t be handled automatically, and notifies the right people for them to weigh in. For example, it might be your lawyer for indemnity issues, CS lead for renewal terms, and IT for special security procedures/certifications.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94771&key=user_uploads/71220/c61e5a05-75a4-4f95-a66d-cf4f618bb057)

Each time a human weighs in, they can make a decision for just this one case or have Gerri generate a rule to handle this decision going forward. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94771&key=user_uploads/71220/a1877eb9-5798-4ba5-8b31-eac429cd02b1)

The end result is your contracts get reviewed before you even realize they’re in your inbox, and deals close faster.

[Check out Gerri and get three contracts reviewed for free. ](https://commonpaper.com/product/ai-agent)

launches.title: 📃 Common Paper - Faster sales with standard contracts & structured data 📃
launches.tagline: Common Paper helps startups close deals with their customers faster and with less risk.
launches.body:
TLDR: If you want to close deals faster/shorten your sales cycles with standardized contracts and a platform that helps eliminate back and forth, [we’d love for you to try us out](https://commonpaper.com/)!

# Background

We (Jake and Ben) met while working together at a BI startup called RJMetrics. Jake was a co-founder, and Ben was an engineering leader. At that job and others, we were incredibly **frustrated by contract negotiation**. The process was filled with:

* **⏳ Unpredictable delays**
* **💰 Huge legal bills**
* **🥽 Extremely limited visibility**

We realized that founders and go-to-market teams have many of the same problems with sales that were widespread in startup fundraising before the introduction of the SAFE. Each company has a unique sales or procurement contract (and NDA, DPA, etc).  People argue over whose template to use, and **no matter who wins that argument, one side of the deal has to review and negotiate a new contract for the first time**.

The same basic ideas show up in all contracts about a given type of transaction, but they are expressed totally differently.  As an example, take governing law, one of the simplest terms in most contracts.  These are real examples from four contracts, showing four different ways describe governing law:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68207&key=user_uploads/71220/b869c8db-5099-478e-855d-b34c5b28bf55)

# Standard Contracts & Structured Data

To solve this, we looked to the SAFE and other widely used contracts for inspiration and created standard, open-source contracts for buying and selling software, including:

* [Design Partner Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/design-partner-agreement/)
* [Mutual NDA](https://commonpaper.com/standards/mutual-nda/)
* [Terms of Service](https://commonpaper.com/standards/terms-of-service/)
* [Cloud Service Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/cloud-service-agreement/) 
* [Data Processing Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/data-processing-agreement/), [Service Level Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/service-level-agreement/), and more

These contracts have been downloaded by thousands of companies, are created by a committee of attorneys, and are free to use under a Creative Commons license. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68207&key=user_uploads/71220/bc9fd4c5-56c8-48ed-8ab2-dd024fa5b974)

Using standard contracts reduces back and forth, accelerates sales cycles, and makes it easier for everyone involved to understand what the contracts actually mean.

In addition to the contracts themselves, we’ve built a new kind of [contract management platform](https://commonpaper.com/product/) for startups.  It makes automation, negotiation, and programmatic access to contract data all way faster and easier than ever before. These kinds of tools have traditionally been built for managing unstructured text, and we’ve built Common Paper on top of the **standards and structured data**. 

**⌚ 63% of the deals on our platform close within 24 hours ⏲️**

We also built the [SaaS Agreement Toolkit](https://commonpaper.com/resources/saas-agreement-toolkit), which combines the standard agreements with step by step guides to help founders:

* Choose which contracts to use based on their stage and business model
* Understand the meaning of different terms within the contracts

The toolkit also includes a benchmark report based on the real contracts of more than 150 companies, with data on what positions are most common and how different terms influence the odds of getting your contract signed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68207&key=user_uploads/71220/b4ae10b3-d5bf-4439-b700-df82cb92e521)

If you want to shorten your sales cycle, save money, and reduce risk with standardized contracts and a platform that helps eliminate back and forth, [we’d love for you to try us out](https://commonpaper.com/)!

Revenue-facing teams in B2B companies run all their operations on customer data, whether it is managing an advertising budget, launching integrated campaigns, closing deals, or retaining customers. # What is Synch?

Synch is a unified sales platform for both your Sales and Sales Ops teams. We work out of the box with Salesforce with no implementation time required.

# **The World Today**

Revenue tech is incredibly fragmented. Almost everyone uses Salesforce, but they don’t build auxiliary products well. This has led to a long tail of point-solution companies that only handle tiny portions of the sales team’s workflows. You buy one product for forecasting, one for pipeline management, another for lead routing, etc.

Additionally, even though all these point solutions pull customer data from a common spot (Salesforce), none of them "talk to each other."

We are building a company that gives you each of those SKUs while also giving you the tools to manage your SFDC environment. We want you to spend less time worrying about your tools and systems and more time worrying about your leads and prospects.

In our previous roles, it became increasingly clear that more time was spent on non-revenue generating activities than selling. Sales leadership spends an inordinate amount of time managing their tech stack, evaluating new vendors, and training their team on using tools - all at the expense of closing deals. 

# **Our Solution**

**For your Sales team**, we offer many different SKUs with a shared analytics suite so leaders can spend less time evaluating multiple vendors. launches.tagline: Global and EU compliant outreach. Run targeted email, LinkedIn and letter campaigns.
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We are Lucas and Stefan from Venta AI. A year ago we launched an outreach tool for Europe and soon had to learn about EU-compliance laws. Since cold mailing is not legal in most of Europe, we implemented LinkedIn and letters as alternative and highly effective outreach channels. Today we are launching Venta AI 2.0 -compliant AI SDR that can run multi-channel outreach campaigns to highly targeted prospects globally.

**TL;DR:** Venta AI is a legally compliant AI SDR that automates prospecting and cold outreach via letters, LinkedIn and email. Thanks to our AI-based qualification and multi-channel approach you can reach every customer, avoid landing in SPAM and increase your reply rates at least 2x.

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BjDrlGZCb0**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BjDrlGZCb0\*\*)

**Meet Europe’s strict regulations on cold outreach**

When we started cold outreach, compliance wasn’t top of mind. We knew that many EU countries have restrictions and informed our users about them. But soon enough one user received a cease and desist letter for sending a cold email and had to pay a hefty fine. This incident prompted us to take a closer look. EU regulations generally forbid sending electronic messages without an explicit opt-in. In many cases, enforcement might be lax, but if you run afoul of these laws, you could face everything from a cease and desist letter (with fines in the hundreds) to a lawsuit (potential fines of up to hundreds of thousands) or even a severe GDPR violation, which can result in penalties reaching millions.

If you think this is solely a European issue, you might also want to check out Canada’s anti-spam legislation (CASL) or Australia’s Spam Act.

**Email deliverability is a nightmare**

The second problem everyone faces with cold mailing is email deliverability. People have written enough about this on Bookface, so I will just say: it becomes a never ending cat and mouse game between cold mailers and email service providers (mainly Gmail and especially Outlook).

**Compliant ways to reach out**

If you don't want to break any laws in the above countries, you have 3 options for cold outreach:

* LinkedIn messages (allowed if connection request accepted)
* Phone calls (allowed with "presumed consent")
* Sending letters (always allowed)

Since LinkedIn limits how much you can send and phone calls take a lot of time, there is only one truly compliant and infinitely scalable way to cold outreach: letters.

**Launching Venta AI 2.0 - compliant outreach at scale**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88760&key=user_uploads/1367242/8ae24024-3a29-4a24-8ab4-2cfefb753cc7)

Today we are launching Venta AI 2.0, which allows you to run multi-channel outreach via email, LinkedIn and letters, while remaining compliant in each country.

Since letters need to be printed and postage paid, we help you use this channel as cost-efficiently and effectively as possible:

1. **Qualification**: Venta AI qualifies accounts based on your own questions, such as: "Is this a logistics company that uses electric trucks". This helps to ensure that you are only contacting your ICPs.
2. **Contact Picking**: Letters should only be sent to 1-2 people in a company. Venta AI always selects the most appropriate contact from all employees in a company based on your buying personas.
3. **The correct postal address:** As described [here](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/posts/86152), we have learned the hard way that many business addresses in company databases are just plain wrong. So we scrape the addresses directly from a company's website, select the location closest to our prospect and validate the address before sending.
4. **CTAs & Traceability:** Letters work differently than emails. To bridge the gap from analog to digital, we always include personalized QR codes on every letter. You get an instant Slack notification with the contact's number when they scan it.
5. **Saving money on sending**: You can send worldwide directly from our platform and simply pay with credits in your subscription.

**What to expect from letters**

We ran several campaigns testing letters directly against email, sending the same message to the same ICP (CEOs in marketing agencies). Email campaigns were run with fully warmed up Gmail accounts, optimized sending times and AI spintax. Letter campaigns were printed with a handwritten font.

On average across 1200 contacts we saw a **2x improvement** in reply rate (4.5% from letters vs. 2.5% from emails) and meeting booked rate (1.5% vs. 0.6%).

# **Let’s get physical**

Want to try letters as an additional or compliant way of reaching customers?

Let’s talk. Contact us at [lucas@getventa.ai](https://mailto:lucas@getventa.ai) or book a demo at <https://www.getventa.ai/trial>

# TL;DR

# **The problem**

The coarse filtering capabilities of current lead databases cause sales teams to sift through long irrelevant leads lists instead of spending their time closing high-opportunity deals. This is money, time, and energy out the window.

### **The solution**

Unhaze integrates directly into Salesforce/Hubspot and tells you which leads to prioritize working on. Gone are the days of manual work and “gut based” decision making. Instead, teams can rely on predictive AI to identify the prospects they are most likely to win.

The initial focus is on win likelihood optimization, but Unhaze can also make predictions such a recommended products, segmentation, upsell potential or even completely custom models.

# **How it works**

_1\. Data foundation_

Unhaze continuously mines both structured and unstructured data across a large palette of data points such as firmographics, geo, technographics, funding, news, intent, website content, job posts, organizational changes & new hires and more.

_2\. Analysis of past deals_

With guidance from you, Unhaze analyzes all previous deals to discover impactful signals that can predict high-conversion opportunities. Some signals are obvious while others are more subtle or only appear in certain combinations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72922&key=user_uploads/530674/4b6c7252-b344-4bb1-845a-dea75a1810fe)

_3\. Predictive monitoring of market_

Unhaze uses machine learning to continuously monitor your market and predict which accounts are most likely to convert - so you can target the right accounts at the right time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72922&key=user_uploads/530674/16e1646b-f44d-46bc-9d26-5699587da1af)

# **Does it work?**

By focusing on the right accounts and not wasting time on unlikely leads, our pilot customers can more than double win rates while markedly decreasing time spent on prospecting.

Businesses use Raz to build interactive and personalized forms. Our AI-powered follow-up questions and semantic analysis provide businesses with actionable insights for constant improvement.

💪 **Our Team**

Hi everyone! We are Rob and Alex, the co-founders of Raz.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74000&key=user_uploads/1379612/47331463-94a6-45c8-9eb1-d6540b8d9207)

We met on our high school tennis team 10 years ago and have remained friends ever since. 

Rob got his MS in AI at Carnegie Mellon after working at Regeneron, Amazon, and his own beef jerky company. His last role was as a Machine Learning Engineer at Scale AI, where he trained LLMs for their enterprise customers. 

Alex, a former sumo wrestler born in Tokyo, was a consultant on PwC's Customer Service and Advocacy team. There, he worked with emerging technologies like 5G and later went on to become the youngest PM at the firm.

**❌ The Problem**

While at PwC, Alex saw firsthand how businesses were losing customers due to a lack of understanding of the user experience. Many companies would attempt to learn from users by sending them a **generic form**, often failing to receive actionable insights. Since forms are static, they lack the ability to probe deep into user experiences, leading to shallow responses that often leave companies with more questions than answers.

**✅ Our Solution**

By enabling forms to **leverage context** when asking questions, Raz makes them more engaging and personalized, helping to get answers to the burning questions businesses have. When a user answers with an ambiguous response, Raz will rephrase the question or delve into an aspect of their response.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74000&key=user_uploads/1379612/255ef80e-84df-433c-b441-cde8d6a084f2)

Forms are used extensively across business operations – from feedback surveys to hiring applications to lead qualification – creating an opportunity for companies to significantly enrich data collection using Raz.

Since Raz can chat with users, it can be deployed over SMS and voice calls – prime channels due to their high engagement. We make this process as simple as **one click**. Rather than sending an SMS with a link to a survey, we offer a native SMS experience that feels like chatting with a company representative.

Below is an example of an SMS hiring form for a food delivery courier created with Raz. For open-ended questions, companies can enable AI to dig deeper into applicants' answers. Raz can even simulate the conversation to show how it could progress.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74000&key=user_uploads/1379612/3e091767-6e9a-425f-a811-bcb25a9db738)

After users complete the forms, Raz provides businesses with the responses, in addition to an analysis that highlights important themes and relevant insights.

launches.tagline: Generate reliable and accurate responses to security reviews, RFPs, DDQs, and RFIs and lower your time-to-revenue.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** _Sales information requests are an important part of most sales deals. But they are long and tedious to complete accurately and need repeated involvement from senior team members. Inventive AI automates this process using AI. Our platform natively manages the fidelity of each response by providing sources, a confidence rating and automatically flagging stale content._

### **Problem ⚠️**

A sales information request like a security questionnaire, RFI, DDQ and RFP is an important step to complete in every sales deal. Each one’s a grind though! A typical sales questionnaire has an average of 77 questions and the average time to complete one is 32 human hours.

* Coordinating the completion of a sales information request usually takes days to weeks depending on the complexity. Dhiren faced this challenge with his sales team at Viewics where they had momentum in the sales motion but they knew that this step would slow down time to revenue. No one person has the answers to all the questions which makes it challenging to search for answers in a knowledge base or chase down answers from the SMEs who are senior team members → and busy with their day job!
* If an answer is found in a knowledge base, it’s difficult for the coordinator to ascertain if the content is current or obsolete. Inevitably, this uncertainty leads to a senior team member having to validate the answer. Result → Slows down the sales motion!

### **Our Solution 👋**

The Inventive AI platform automates drafting responses that can be trusted and does so in a fraction of the time compared to the current process. We do this by:

* **Generating responses grounded in facts:** We use your previous responses and connect to company knowledge bases to generate a response. For each answer, we include easily accessible citations to the sources used to generate the answer.
* **Creating a Confidence Rating:** We generate a confidence rating for each answer and automatically flag answers that need review.
* **Detecting Stale Content:** We automatically flag content that could be obsolete and thereby inaccurate.
* **Creating compelling answers:** You have control over the tone of the answers while keeping the facts intact.

Our goal is that you only have to **_verify responses,_** not create them from scratch for every sales information request. Most existing SaaS tools cater to streamlining the process of response creation. With our AI native solution, our customers only verify flagged answers while we do the heavy lifting of generating an accurate response to each question.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73748&key=user_uploads/150549/7482b2fd-7d43-4036-a5ce-50016d40c592)

### **Team** 🍻

We are an SF Bay Area native team who met through our friend’s circle and hit it off on our love and passion for AI & building businesses.

[**Dhiren**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhiren9/) previously founded and led Viewics (series-B, acquired by Roche), a SaaS company in healthcare analytics that managed data for **100Mn+ patients** across customers like Mayo Clinic, University Hospitals, and Children’s Hospitals.

[**Gaurav**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gauravnemade/) was a product manager at **Google AI and Google Brain** and led go-to-market for the LLM platform - LaMDA - which eventually ended up powering Google Bard v1.

[**Vishakh**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishakhhegde/) led mission-critical Machine Learning efforts at **Ambient AI** (YC17, A16z) and has authored a book on Deep Learning. He has a Masters's in ML from Stanford.

[**Waffle**](https://photos.app.goo.gl/wbrecuk6xnHjBim68) is a world leader in sniffing for treats and cheering us up on hard days. She is our (non-AI) Happiness Agent.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73748&key=user_uploads/1359485/ef976aa8-0d12-410f-a569-6b44fc5a2247)

### **Requests** 👋🏻

launches.title: 🚢 Cargo, the revenue architecture for modern teams

launches.body:
### **tl;dr**

Cargo is the first revenue architecture built for modern teams. We help revenue teams to access their company data and automate their sales operations. We provide a headless interface to enable them to easily segment, score and route leads to turn pipeline into revenue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/4de69132-aa36-4e7e-9574-a34127936fa2)

Salut 🇫🇷, we are Aurelien and Max, 2 passionated people about data and go-to-market with more than 10+ experience. We previously met at Spendesk where we used to built together the revenue engine in house, feeding more than 200 sales on autopilot, in our 3 different markets and bringing the meeting booked rate from 5% to 15%.

### **All in one CRM are dead**

Over the past years, the number of tools used by revenue teams have increased significantly. Sales/marketing/finance data and workflows exist in disparate systems and share different definitions.

5 years ago, companies started to invest a lot in data tools (like Dagster, reverseETL, DBT) to consolidate these fragmented data and build their revenue source of truth in Snowflake instead of Salesforce.

However, the modern data stack has made revenue teams more than ever dependent from data teams. This ended up creating too technical and unmaintainable revenue workflows.

Today, and especially in this downturn period, companies are looking do more with less. The future belongs to compounds softwares. RevOps teams need to unify their operations in one place without compromising the flexibility.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/a22f9668-bd79-4c62-ad66-ff9a43bce097)

### **The opportunity**

In today’s reality, 80% of SaaS companies offer a sales-driven customer approach. Even with the new hype of PLG as a GTM motion, there is more than never a need to prioritize on which accounts the sales reps should focus their energy.

**Current systems don’t solve marketing and sales alignment**

For years, the alignment of sales and marketing has been somewhat of a mythical beast in the business world, eluding even the best of us. Companies still have disparate data leading to disconnected customer journeys. Cargo serves as the glue between your revenue stack, so you can easily orchestrate [Allbound strategy](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/tshaped-marketer_allbound-sales-realbuyerjourney-activity-6982722735391006721-K7LQ?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) _(ie: coupling inbound & outbound approaches)._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/e75a4042-59a5-4e5b-9028-8847c1c139f8)

**Current systems don’t make sales rep more efficient**

Sales spend only 1/3 of their time selling: the [Salesforce State of Sales 5th edition](https://www.salesforce.com/content/dam/web/en_gb/www/pdf/state-of-sales-5th-edition.pdf) study reveals that Sales reps spend only 28% of their week actually selling. This is a sobering statistic in an era where AI and automation are advancing at a rapid pace. Cargo automates the entire pre-sales journey (waterfall enrichment, data verification, lead prioritization, account assignment & routing to sales sequences + write AI powered sales notes to let sales reps drive meaningful conversation with prospects) and follow the boom of revenue operations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/d8e865f3-63f2-48d1-9221-50e846f0c3f6)

The revenue operations market is considered currently as the fastest growing market and is projected to be multiplied by 3 in 2028.

### **The solution**

We designed Cargo by getting the most out of unbundling and bundling architectures. Cargo sits directly on top of your company data. We built a set of features to allow revOps teams to easily manage their revenue data & workflows.

**Setup your system of record**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/639d1103-fb26-4c5b-baf8-99e73d435c03)

Keep the control and flexibility of your data. Your data warehouse is used as the backend of Cargo and data are never stored on our side. Easily leverage the data models built by your data teams and connect them to your revenue sources.

**Define your business entities**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/09b5b961-2b09-4126-a5d5-09290eef9087)

Be versatile by defining the entities that make sense for your business or use cases. PLG or SLG, Inbound or Outbound, Fintech or Ecommerce, …

**Create your segments**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/a73a418a-2690-4a08-a968-2ef51ddb442c)

Create segments without writing any lines of SQL

**Build and deploy your workflows**

Orchestrate your prospect and customer journeys to systematize your sales process and ensure sales reps are loaded up with qualified accounts at scale.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72778&key=user_uploads/1182415/9604c20f-6593-4047-bcd6-966227970d91)

## **Asks**

* If you want to grow your pipeline and get more revenue with the same resource, [book a demo with us](https://calendly.com/max-growth/30min) directly and we’ll get you a VIP onboarding asap.
* Connect us to CRO, Sales ops / Rev ops leaders in your network.

### **Stay in the loop**

* Sign up on <https://getcargo.io>
* Check our [Changelog](http://changelog.getcargo.io) and [Documentation](https://docs.getcargo.io)
* Follow us on [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cargo-hq)

launches.title: Ami by AiSDR: AI GTM agent that builds your full outbound motion
launches.tagline: Trained on 3 years of data across 27 industries, 17k+ campaigns and 20k+ booked meetings
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋

Yuriy here - founder of AiSDR (YC S23). This is my second YC company. The first (AXDRAFT – YC W19) was acquired by Onit in 2020.

Today we’re launching **Ami**, an AI GTM agent that already knows what good outbound looks like. Ami builds your campaign, and runs it across email and LinkedIn until a meeting’s booked.

What makes it different is what happens next. Ami remembers every campaign it’s run for you, spots what isn’t working, fixes it on your say-so, and tells you what to run next.

## TL;DR

* Point Ami at your website and it builds your campaign in 20 minutes against what’s worked across 17,150+ campaigns across 27 industry-specific playbooks. 
* Every decision is driven by data, and Ami pushes back when it thinks your direction is off.
* Targeting is pain-based. Ami looks for evidence that someone has your problem right now, and validates the timing before sending a message.
* Ami remembers everything it’s run for you, so Month 3 is better than Month 1.
* Self-serve for $250/month. No demo required to start.
* **Try it at** <https://aisdr.com/ai-gtm-agent-ami/>

[Launch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z--7OETsjrs)

## The Problem

AI outbound got very good at scaling noise. But it struggled at making sales judgments.

Almost every AI SDR, ours included, assumed the human would bring the strategy, define the ICP, create the angle, and hit approve. The AI would take it from there and do it all faster than any human.

This works if you already know what a good campaign looks like. A lot of people buying these tools don’t:

* First-time founders running founder-led sales
* First sales hires
* 2-person GTM teams

Working out which of 42+ possible audiences is worth spending time on and deciding what to say is a skill built over years. 

So we handed that decision back to buyers and called it control. So did everyone else.

What came out the other end is thousands of messages and full dashboards, but zero pipeline.

The missing piece was never speed. It was judgment. And no one had automated it.

## Our Solution – Ami AI

For 3 years, we built execution: research, writing, sequencing, deliverability, reply handling. And the thing customers kept telling us was still hard was the part we hadn't automated – deciding what campaign to run in the first place, and when to stop and pivot to something else.

The number that settled it was 80% of our customers were using our campaign generator instead of building campaigns by hand, even though building gave them far more control. 

People wanted a decision rather than controls.

So we took what we learned from over 17,150 campaigns run on the platform in the past 3 years, and built the agent that does it. 

That's Ami.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/7df84866-6f8f-476e-8d12-7e12ad99005d)

### Where Ami’s judgment comes from

In a nutshell, 3 years of running outbound as a company that sells outbound. As of September 2026, this means (adding daily):

Campaigns run - 17,150

Emails sent - 2,546,096

Meetings booked - 19,501

Customers served - 1,150

Industries served - 27

Every one of those campaigns taught Ami something about what lands, in which industry, at what moment. That's the part you can't buy off the shelf, and that’s why this took three years.

**1. Ami builds your campaign from your website, CRM, and industry best practices, against everything we’ve learned:** Give Ami your URL and it reads your site, and share access to your CRM. Ami then runs what it found against your industry and the 17K+ campaigns we’ve done over 3 years, and comes back with the angles and audiences you need. You can argue with Ami: narrow the ICP, push a different angle, or ask why it picked what it did.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/c36e16a8-d236-41be-bb97-8f133a06f758)

**2. Ami targets pains:** Most tools match a profile and hope the timing is right. Ami looks for evidence someone has the problem you solve. There's no fixed database. Describe who you want and Ami finds them, with data verified at the time of the search.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/59022bd3-8755-4def-9ecb-2c47fac6b9ab)

**3. Ami remembers, and it gets better at your sales motions**: This is where Ami’s value compounds. Ami keeps every campaign it’s run for you: angles that landed, segments that went quiet, objections that kept coming up, and things you tried. It tells you what’s breaking and why when performance drops, and it makes fixes once you give the green light. Month 3 is better than Month 1 because Ami has 3 months of your outbound in its head. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/031002d5-65f8-4470-91c3-97fc2a0caae7)

An AI that learns your business and doesn’t need babysitting is what this category’s promised since Day 1 (ours included). It took 3 years, 17K campaigns, and 2.5M emails before we had enough to build it..

You don’t have to be good at outbound to win with Ami.

That’s the whole point.

## tl;dr

**AiSDR automates sales prospecting.** Our software uses generative AI to write and send sales emails to prospective customers. Once a prospect engages, AiSDR automatically corresponds with the prospect with the goal of getting a meeting booked. In just 2 months, AiSDR already has 24 customers. The response rate of our sales emails is on par with the industry’s rate for emails written by humans. This is our second time as YC founders after we sold our first company AXDRAFT (W19) to Onit Inc.

If you want to learn more - [book a demo with us](https://calendly.com/aisdr-intro/demo).

## Problem

Do you want to scale your SDR team without growing your headcount or significantly raising your operating costs? AiSDR will make it easier for your business to stay lean and mean. 

If you’re faced with any of these challenges, AiSDR is the SDR for you:

* Inbound/outbound leads are lost because you can’t answer in <10 minutes
* You run 1-3 generic email campaigns that don’t convert because you don’t have the time to create personalized campaigns
* You’re uncomfortable with sending follow-ups because they seem “salesy” or “spammy”
* You want to scale your email outreach but you don’t have the budget to confidently hire an SDR

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74643&key=user_uploads/208580/06a07780-7d1c-4c5e-8daf-a0db770f621d)

## Solution

**For a fraction of the cost of a full-time, in-house SDR,** AiSDR will use your leads and personas to (a) create personalized email campaigns for each lead, (b) send personalized follow-ups to leads, and (c) correspond and drive leads to book a meeting with you. 

This will help you scale your outreach without increasing headcount while giving you the freedom to experiment with campaigns before hiring your first full-time SDR.

Long story short, AiSDR is the AI SDR that will grow your pipeline, optimize SDR costs, and give you the freedom to reinvest revenue into growing your business.

## How it works

AiSDR leverages generative AI to create personalized email campaigns at scale using lead data and sales personas. Since AiSDR never needs to sleep, it will respond to and follow up with engaged leads in less than 10 minutes, ensuring that **prospective clients never fall through the cracks** due to lack of time.

AiSDR will also help with developing and fine-tuning personas, cleaning leads, and warming up inboxes so that emails don’t land in spam.

launches.body:
TL;DR - [Topo](https://www.topo.io/) is an AI sales agent trained specifically for each company. The agent is trained to handle all outbound tasks automatically: finding the best leads in the industry-specific channels and then automatically contacting prospects with a personalized approach.

### **The problem 🤯**

B2B lead generation is broken.

It's difficult to generate outbound pipeline as we did in the past years: mass mailing over the TAM based on demographics criteria.

It's especially very human-intensive for a founder, a full cycle sales team, or even an SDR dedicated to the task.

Finally, the cost of implementing a high-quality outbound strategy has completely exploded.

### **Our Solution 🥳**

AI allows us to automate these tasks by doing like a top performer.

**What makes a top performer?**

* They know the product, the industry, the pain points, and the company's value proposition perfectly.
* They will find the right leads, ready to buy, based on buying signals in the industry-specific channels or on the company's website visitors.

_For example, the buying signals for a dev tool will likely happen more on GitHub, whereas for an HRIS, it will happen on LinkedIn or job boards._

That's what we do: **Create the smartest AI sales agent on the market - custom-trained for each company!**

### **How it works? ✨**

1. Train your agent to become an expert on your business thanks to various knowledge sources of your company (Knowledge base, CRM, Call transcripts…).
2. The agent will then scan the lead sources specific to your industry and start to suggest enriched leads with a personalized approach.
3. In co-pilot mode, you will be able to validate the leads and approaches to train the agent and then switch to autopilot once satisfied with the lead quality.
4. The agent will book meetings in your calendar.

### **Meet our team 🤝**

[Dan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danelkaim/) and [Robin](https://linkedin.com/in/robin-philibert) were together as Sales and Head of Outbound at Aircall from $10M to $120M ARR - they perfectly know the sales and SDR profession to reproduce best practices.

[Léonard](https://linkedin.com/in/leonard-henriquez) is a Data Science and AI expert and managed an engineering team of 10 people in his previous startup.

We are the right team to launch a smart AI sales agent :)

### **Our ask 🙏**

If you're looking to create pipeline via outbound and you tick one of these boxes:

* You are afraid of automating because the outreach or the leads would not be qualitative enough
* You don't want to recruit a first sales before your PMF
* You have full cycle salespeople who struggle to consistently create pipe
* You want to test a new market
* You think it’s too expensive to hire an SDR

Please contact us at [**dan@topo.io**](mailto:dan@topo.io) or check out [**topo.io.**](http://topo.io/)

It pushes the most relevant content to buyers to animate sales cycles, encouraging buy-in while alleviating the sales rep from endless admin and follow-ups.

Hello YC 👋

We are thrilled to share [Topo.io](http://Topo.io) with you - a Buyer Engagement Platform that helps B2B sellers better engage buyers to accelerate closing.

🤯 **The Problem**

**The B2B selling process is broken.**

85% of B2B buying decisions happen outside of conversations with the sales rep.

This leaves Sales teams facing:

* longer sales cycles
* lack of momentum
* increasing number of stakeholders
* and difficulty in scaling a proven sales process.

Having a background in B2B sales, we experienced these problems first-hand. Unable to find a tool that could solve these problems, we decided to build one ourselves 💪

⚡️ **The Solution**

Topo is a Buyer Engagement Platform that allows sales reps to keep all of their interactions in one place, facilitating collaboration, increasing engagement, and creating sales motions at scale. It includes the following key features:

* **Digital Sales Room** - Establish a deal hub that sellers can use to engage buyers, pushing them the most relevant content to animate down times during a deal.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76388&key=user_uploads/1148042/94b18c3c-3319-4ce1-812f-bbf8f8aa0fed)

* **Automations** - Set up workflows to automate the rhythm of your follow-ups: content sharing, follow-up on low-engagement stakeholders, receive action suggestions in Slack…
* **Engagement & Collaboration** - Make the sales cycle more self-service with our mutual action plan, engage all internal and external stakeholders, and enable sales to anticipate what’s coming next in their deal.
* **Analytics** - Observe when, how, and how long your customers/prospects are interacting with your content to better prioritize opportunities via deal scoring.
* **Integrations** - Create a workspace from your CRM (Salesforce & HubSpot), keep your data up-to-date with two-way sync, be informed about the latest buyer activity via Slack, and enrich your workspace with content from your existing tools (Gong, Loom, Google Slide, Youtube, etc.).

🔥**Our customers shortened their sales cycles by 30% just two quarters after implementing Topo**🔥

**👫 Who are we?**

We’re a team of 9 people, French and American - from Paris, France. 🇫🇷

We’re all from B2B SaaS companies (ex Hubspot, Algolia, Aircall, Hivebrite...) with a strong background in GTM. It was during our previous experience at Aircall that the Topo adventure was born.

## **❌ The Problem: Cold Outbound is Dying**

Selling is harder than ever.

Modern founders are facing modern problems:

* An average B2B company sends [306 cold emails](https://belkins.io/blog/cold-email-response-rates) to get 1 lead.
* Email providers like Gmail have lowered [email spam report thresholds to 0.3%](https://www.cnbc.com/2023/10/03/googles-making-big-changes-to-prevent-gmail-spam.html) before your domain’s deliverability rate is compromised.
* LinkedIn limits you to [100-200 messages per week](https://evaboot.com/blog/linkedin-limits).
* Competition is fiercer than ever. True product differentiation is hard to find and harder to sustain in an age of plummeting software costs.

## **🎉 The Solution: Warm Intros = Sales**

So how can you stand out and book more sales calls with buyers?

Easy - with a **warm intro** through one of their personal connections.

In addition to helping you book calls, warm intros also buy you **trust**, the key to successful sales.

84% of B2B buyers start the purchasing process with a referral, and sales close 46% faster when a partner is involved.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79400&key=user_uploads/606466/51099453-be3d-490b-95d9-3df575d623af)

## **⚙️ How it Works**

[PartnerHQ](https://trypartnerhq.com) is a marketplace where B2B businesses can find and buy introductions.

PartnerHQ is for you if:

* You're tired of asking your own network for intros and favors.
* VCs are pressuring you to sell to larger companies.
* Cold outbound isn't working.

To get started:

1. **Describe your Ideal Customer Profile.** Specify what types of people you would like an intro to.
2. **Set your bounty.** Decide how much you will pay for an intro to your ideal buyer. The average bounty on PartnerHQ is $500 per intro.
3. **Watch your inbox.** Respond to intro emails and book sales calls with engaged prospects.

**The Problem**

I (Grant) spent four years at Salesforce as a Sales Engineer and saw firsthand how frustrating CRMs can be. Despite massive investments, CRMs often become messy and unreliable, burdened with stale data, duplicates, and manual data entry. CRMs promise so much, but never live up to their full potential.  

**“The biggest thing I learned at Salesforce was that everyone hates Salesforce…”** 

So why is this the case? Why hasn’t this been solved already? Well, it’s a hard problem, and many have tried over the years (Salesforce included): 

* CRMs are incredibly complicated, unique, and accumulate tech debt
* There is an enormous amount of source data to make sense of (emails, calls, files, transcripts, etc.)

 

**Why It Matters**

Sales reps spend 30-50% of their time on grunt work (CRM updates, follow-up emails, quotes/documentation, etc.), and yet we still can't rely on our CRM for reporting, accountability, or automation. 

Businesses suffer from:

* Wasted time - on grunt work instead of customers 
* Unreliable data - lack of accountability, reporting, automation, and insights
* Revenue left on the table - opportunities fall through the cracks

 

**Our Solution**

CRMs are absolutely critical to our business, but they need to be smarter… and thanks to AI, they can be. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91926&key=user_uploads/318114/001c4bc7-125d-4415-bbee-a50768315513)

* **Global Search** - Instantly find important details across emails, CRM records, calendar events, call recordings, notes, and documents with one simple search.

crmCopilot integrates into your existing tools/workflow, enhancing your systems rather than replacing them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79117&key=user_uploads/318114/f3f42547-5b9a-470b-8220-d7eae8602281)

Hey everyone! We are [Garrett (left)](https://linkedin.com/in/graves-dev) and [Grant (right)](https://linkedin.com/in/grantmargerum), the founders of Quantic. We are building **the future of sales intelligence, a next-generation data platform.** If there’s one thing we’ve learned it’s that sales is hard. But it doesn’t have to be. Today, sales reps navigate between countless tools looking for an edge, an insight, or a lead. They are limited by their time and their workflows. ### **TL;DR**

[CardLift](https://withcardlift.com) builds co-branded browser extensions to help credit card issuers maximize their share of wallet (and, in turn, per-user revenue).

### How It Works

We build your credit card program a co-branded browser extension. When a user signs up for your card, you can incentivize them to add your extension to their browser. Your users are now 2 - 4x more valuable.

**Migrate Existing Spend**

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=82885&key=user_uploads/1843987/39dd468e-f9db-4e37-99de-e26e987eb907)

When your credit card program onboards a new user, we make it dead simple for them to switch their card-on-file at all of their top online merchants to your card with one click.

Our AI-powered browser extension not only automatically detects where your users spend the most (Netflix, Amazon, T-mobile, Progressive), but also lets them switch out their primary payment method to your card with one click. Users press a button in their browser, and their card-on-file everywhere instantly switches to their shiny new card (your card!).

Offer your users an incentive to make this switch, and watch your per-user GMV transaction volume skyrocket even more.

**Ensure You Continue To Capture Future Spend**

We don’t just help when a user signs up to your card program. Our fast checkout technology embeds “One Tap Checkout ” on the checkout page at over 50,000 e-commerce sites - making your card the easiest way for users to complete any transaction on their browser.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=82885&key=user_uploads/1843987/3b3cd133-188f-4cc5-ae83-acc536f9a3af)

You can even customize the copy to tell the user why to use your card for that specific purchase. For example, if you were Chase, you could prompt your users to use their Sapphire Preferred card on Avis BECAUSE it offers car rental insurance.

**Make Your Card Program More Rewarding**

For the final cherry on top, we partner with over 1,000 of the country’s top merchants to offer additional affiliate-based cash back that you can add to your existing cashback. Your users can now earn double or even triple the cash back on Sephora when they use your “One Tap Checkout” button instead of their other cards.

launches.title: Crustdata - Web Search API for AI Agents
launches.tagline: Fastest and most accurate web search API for people, companies and events
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re **Chris, Abhilash, and Manmohit** - founders of [**Crustdata**](https://crustdata.com) (YC F24). We’re restructuring the web for AI agents by building the **first search engine built specifically for AI agents** to find information on **people, companies, and events**.

This launch is our [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch) - the fastest, most accurate way for agents to get **structured, fresh web data** they can actually act on.

🎥 Demo video 👇

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IouWW97hBN8>

## **TL;DR**

* 🧠 [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch) for AI agents: real-time search + fetch → structured data mapped to a canonical entity
* 🧩 Proprietary indexing algorithm that **maps every relevant web document back to the correct person/company entity**
* 🏗 Built on **2 years of verified people + firmographic data APIs**, now extended to index the rest of the web
* 🔎 Pair it with our [**People Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/people-discovery) to find the right people, then pull the freshest context from the web

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97527&key=user_uploads/508558/e3f61603-9266-4b39-8714-3b48fb680d25)

## **Problem**

The web has _everything_ about people and companies - funding posts, blogs, GitHub, research papers, podcasts, job changes, pricing pages, news - but it’s:

* scattered across **billions of pages**
* written for **humans**
* hard for AI to **reliably connect** into one coherent view

So agents either:

1. scrape brittle HTML and break constantly, or
2. use stale databases and miss what changed this week.

## **Solution**

We spent **2 years** building **verified People + Company APIs**. That gave us high-confidence entity profiles.

Now we’re indexing the **rest of the web** and building a proprietary indexing algorithm that:

1. finds every relevant document about a person/company
2. **maps it to the right entity**
3. returns it as **structured data** that agents can use immediately

That’s the foundation of [**Crustdata Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch).

Think: **a search engine for agents**, where the output isn’t “10 blue links,” but **entity-linked, structured, fresh context from the web**.

---

## **What you can build with it**

### **AI SDR / GTM agents**

* Get the **latest** proof points on a company (launches, funding, exec moves, pricing changes)
* Generate personalization that’s actually timely

### **Recruiting / sourcing agents**

* Identify candidates with the right background using [**People Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/people-discovery)
* Pull the newest context (papers, talks, open source projects, blog posts, news, events) via [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch)

### **Research / diligence agents**

* Track a market/category and continuously attach new web documents to the right companies/people
* Turn web noise into structured signals

---

## **Our ask**

If you’re building an **AI agent** or **GTM tool** and need **real-time people + company data from the web**, check out [**Crustdata**](https://crustdata.com).

* Docs / access: [**Web Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/websearch)
* People discovery: [**People Search API**](https://crustdata.com/apis/people-discovery)
* Book a demo: <https://crustdata.com/demo>

**TL;DR**

We’re building Crustdata which provides live company and people data via APIs and webhooks. We let you watch, enrich, or search for any person or company on LinkedIn - and get updates in real-time.

**🚩 Problem**

Getting fresh, reliable, accurate B2B data at scale is hard.

In 2024, data needs to be live and pinpoint accurate, but most data platforms source from unreliable, poorly maintained 3rd party sources. And the data isn’t updated frequently — monthly, if you’re lucky.

Any company trying to add an intelligence layer to their system or process needs data.

Problem: it’s an incredible technology challenge to do that at scale.

**✅ Solution**

We have developed technology that allows us to index and pipe in live data from almost any data source. Currently, we do this at scale from sources including LinkedIn, the SEC, funding announcements and milestones, employee ratings, product reviews, web traffic -  and deliver this data instantly to our customers.

Our technology also enables you to ‘watch’ companies and people on a live basis. Get monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, or instant updates when a predefined event happens.

Events like:

\- Company grows or declines in headcount

\- Company grows in headcount by certain role

\- Company grows in certain headcount in specific regions

\- Company hires for specific technologies or titles in specific regions

\- Company lists a job posting for a certain title or technology

\- Company announces or closes funding round

\- Company gets a new product review

\- Person changes jobs

\- Person gets a promotion

\- Person adds a new skill

\- Company or Person makes a LinkedIn post

▶️ **Demo**

<https://youtu.be/TwUYDCrdLvk>

**🕰️ Why now**

Clean, fresh, and accurate data is becoming increasingly important. The age of AI is producing whole new product lines and allowing companies to make their sales process smart.

There are AI SDR companies that are totally reliant on fresh, primary source data to run their whole process.

B2B sales teams are depending on appropriate triggers to make sure they are reaching out to the right person at the right time.

Customer success teams need to track key personnel at their customers, in real-time.

Growth equity investors are shifting towards in-house data stacks and models to do their entire deal sourcing.

Early stage startups need a data-driven approach in GTM research to identify the right market they can plant their wedge in.

**🧑🏽‍🤝‍🧑🏻 Team**

We have a decade plus experience building our own separate VC-backed data products. We have spent an inordinate amount of time on the problem which has allowed us to have a unique insight and experience that is tough to replicate.

**🌟 Big vision**

The majority of knowledge work in future will be done by AI agents. Our goal is to wield the web as the data warehouse for the AI agents of the future, starting with people and company data.

[🙋‍♂️](https://emojipedia.org/man-raising-hand)**Learn more:**

Check out our data and API docs if you’re interested:[ **www.crustdata.com**](http://www.crustdata.com)

**TL;DR**

Telehealth clinics spend hundreds of thousands on ads but convert only a fraction of the patients who visit their site.

Buying GLP-1s, TRT, or other treatments is a high-stakes decision, yet most patients are left alone with a website.

Cenote provides AI sales agents that instantly reach out, answer questions, and guide patients through the purchase, helping clinics grow revenue and patients buy with confidence.

**Problem**

Telehealth customer acquisition is extremely expensive.

Clinics often pay hundreds, sometimes thousands, of dollars per lead, yet most visitors never convert.

After spending heavily to acquire demand, clinics rely on two imperfect tools:

* marketing automations with low engagement
* human reps who can’t scale coverage or response time

The result is lost revenue for clinics and confusing shopping experiences for patients making complex medical decisions.

**Insight**

High-consideration healthcare purchases shouldn’t be self-serve websites, they should be guided experiences.

Patients don’t abandon because they aren’t interested, they abandon because they have questions, uncertainty, or timing issues.

In the offline world, these purchases would involve a knowledgeable guide.\
Online, that layer has been missing.

We believe a new default is emerging: instead of navigating complex decisions alone, every buyer will have an intelligent concierge helping them evaluate, decide, and act.

**Solution**

Cenote gives every lead a personalized, persistent sales experience.

Our agents:

* reach out instantly via call and text
* answer questions and qualify needs
* follow up over days or weeks as patients decide
* support use cases like abandoned carts, failed payments, and win-backs

Every lead gets the experience of a dedicated care guide.

**The Impact**

Clinics using Cenote see:

* significantly higher conversion on existing traffic - for one clinic our agent converted at 2x the rate of a human rep
* better patient experiences

Instead of losing demand, they capture it.

**Why now**

AI can now hold natural, helpful conversations at scale.

For the first time, it’s possible to give every patient a guided buying experience, something previously only available to the highest-touch businesses.

**The ask**

We’re looking to speak with:

• Telehealth operators spending heavily on acquisition\
• Patients who recently considered an online health purchase

If that’s you (or someone you know), we’d love to talk.

We’d love your help!

launches.tagline: Cenote eliminates administrative bottlenecks that slow down revenue.
launches.body:
### **tl;dr**

We work with specialist clinics to identify their biggest administrative blockers and deploy custom **AI** to resolve them. Right now, we’re automating **referral intake**, reducing the time it takes for clinics to process new patients and accelerate revenue collection.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u403AnLMSNE>

### **Problem**

Specialist clinics struggle with **slow, manual referral processing**, leading to revenue delays, administrative overload, and patient drop offs. The biggest bottlenecks we've uncovered:

* **Referral processing is manual and slow.** Clinics receive **thousands of referrals per month**, requiring extensive manual effort to extract and enter data.
* **Medical necessity verification is tedious.** Clinics must determine if a referral meets insurance criteria, often requiring **days of back-and-forth with primary care providers** for missing information.
* **Insurance approvals are a major roadblock.** Clinics waste **days negotiating with insurers** to confirm reimbursement eligibility before scheduling treatment.

These inefficiencies cause **40-60% of referrals to drop off and** costs the U.S. healthcare system **over $150 billion annually**. The administrative burden is also immense, with an average of **4.3 administrative staff per doctor** in the American healthcare system.

### **Solution**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXduwoVo9LiyuYd4ldqDHoJxHu2uaKzKbOzQnI4MZ0vlWDvKTY-nE2iokzaFTCR7-7PeqhwdI9FIqtRbpP1FkZ3ivWq6TdtuyftWnKoMCyzw-smhtrM7tZacSCTnDkJ45wF92PRK7w?key=9LANEIwzbMw6NQWGiMH6ii1e)

Cenote eliminates the **referral-to-treatment bottleneck**, allowing clinics to focus on patient care while accelerating revenue collection.

* **Automated data extraction:** We categorize and extract key referral details the moment they hit the clinic’s inbox.
* **Seamless medical necessity verification:** If critical referral data is missing, our system **auto-requests** the necessary information via the preferred form of digital communication.

launches.tagline: Enabling teams of any scale to move at startup speed
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Lost knowledge is lost productivity.

Peppr AI turns scattered company data into a living, self-improving knowledge hub to fuel faster decisions across your organization. Through this, Peppr ensures that **no matter** **how much your team scales in size, it can still operate with the same speed as the leanest startups.** 

**The Problem**

As companies scale, their teams inevitably grow—and so does their information. Projects multiply, contacts proliferate, and goals stack up. Critical details sink into buried Slack threads, outdated Confluence docs, and a myriad of PM tools. This not only leads to incessant handoff meetings and endless email threads, but **90% of critical knowledge remains undocumented (in large U.S. businesses) due to inefficient knowledge-sharing.**

### **Our Solution**

Peppr AI is built to solve these deep-seated knowledge bottlenecks.

**Unlike tools that rely on employees manually documenting what they do (which we all know they don’t ;)**, Peppr autonomously captures critical insights hidden in engineering workflows—surfacing the knowledge that typically goes undocumented.

[Peppr AI Demo](https://youtu.be/toz3hokheXs)

By **autonomously ingesting data** from key platforms, Peppr:

1. **Auto-Generates Internal Documentation**
   * Creates synthesized summaries of daily activity from Slack, Notion, Jira, etc., keeping everyone up to speed.
2. **Offers Intelligent, Real-Time Insights**
   * Pinpoints blockers in projects and recommends intelligent workflows or POCs (Points of Contact) to resolve them.
3. **Develops “Virtual Employee Minds”**
   * Retains institutional knowledge, so when employees leave or are away, their expertise doesn’t have to be waited on and doesn’t walk out the door with them.
4. **Supercharges Existing AI Tools**
   * Empowers AI tools like Cursor and Glean with the most advanced, continuously updating knowledge base, enabling them to operate with deeper context and greater accuracy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87684&key=user_uploads/1481983/ea6c5c9c-368e-451e-978b-fd817e630b03)

Our ‘virtual employee’ dashboard doesn’t just track productivity—it unlocks hidden insights, revealing impact and expertise across the org in real-time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87684&key=user_uploads/1481983/11f1a5c2-30bf-4cb9-8404-bf369d4b9ebe)

A command center for execution—Peppr’s team-wide dashboard pinpoints roadblocks, suggests the fastest resolutions, and ensures work never stalls.

### **Why It Matters**

In the perfect information system, no one wastes time hunting for answers, waiting for replies, or sitting through redundant meetings. **Unfortunately, for most organizations today, it's the opposite.** 

Engineers get blocked searching for past solutions instead of shipping faster. Managers struggle with visibility. Teams waste hours trying to align.

**Peppr changes this.**

Unlike other AI-powered tools, which only surface information that employees have manually written down, **Peppr AI captures and records the knowledge that never makes it into documentation** – so work moves forward instead of in circles.

And because every productivity tool, AI agent, and search system is only as powerful as the data it relies on, Peppr doesn’t just unify knowledge—it supercharges all your existing systems. **Like an internal Scale AI**, it continuously organizes, refines, and contextualizes your data, ensuring every one of your organization’s systems operates at peak efficiency. **No bottlenecks. No blind spots. Just pure execution at startup speed—no matter how big you grow.**

### **Our Ask**

* **Connect us to Series B+ Startups and Enterprise Teams (30+ Employees)** that are struggling with growing silos, inefficiencies, and lost productivity.

launches.body:
# **📜 Background:**

Co-founder Lukas Bock grew up in a family business with over 100 years in plumbing and electrical trades. He’s seen first-hand how manual quoting in the construction industry is.

Inspired by this legacy, Mercura is now using AI to transform how millions of sales reps at distributors & manufacturers work.

# **❌ Problem:**

When contractors bid on construction projects, they request quotes from distributors and manufacturers, often in unstructured formats like emails, Excel files, and PDFs. These requests contain functional product requirements but frequently lack details.

Distributors and manufacturers employ massive inside sales teams that manually interpret these requests, compare specifications with their product catalog, and select suitable products.

This slow, manual, and error-prone process holds off inside sales teams from their core task—selling—while delaying responses to customers and increasing the risk of lost revenue.

<https://youtu.be/Bn-ENaj_6Tc>

# **🪄 Solution:**

Mercura automates sales quotations for HVAC, electrical and plumbing distributors & manufacturers.

By eliminating repetitive back-office tasks with AI, our software enables sales teams to process RFQs in minutes instead of days. This lets them focus on winning more deals and driving revenue.

Our customers use Mercura to quote significantly more requests automatically, which allows them to maximize their sales potential and win more customers.

This is how it works:

1. **Customer request intake** – Requests arrive in various formats (PDFs, Excel, emails, etc.) and must be processed into the ERP.
2. **Data extraction** – Our AI extracts relevant product information, such as product descriptions, types, manufacturers, part numbers, and quantities, and structures it correctly.
3. **Validation & matching** – Our AI matches line items with the distributor’s product catalog, and suggests the best matches based on the customer’s sales history.
4. **ERP entry** – The quote is automatically entered into the ERP.

# **🌟 About us:**

**Lukas Bock** grew up in a family business with over 100 years in construction. After working as an AI engineer at Google X and Data Scientist at Allianz, he’s now back in the industry to transform how sales reps work.

**Hai Dang** is an AI researcher with experience at Meta and Autodesk, holding patents and over ten first-authored papers at top-tier conferences. He’s an expert in human-AI collaboration and now applying his research to this domain.

**Stefan Zheng** improved operations efficiency across 15+ manufacturing plants as a consultant at Bain. He’s excited to drive sales efficiency in wholesale distribution at scale.

# **🙏 Our Ask:**

1. Intro us to HVAC, electrical and plumbing distributors & manufacturers - we give you 20% of the first monthly fee if we close a deal!
2. We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback at [founders@mercura.ai](mailto:founders@mercura.ai)

Your help can make a huge difference. **Thank you!**

\- Lukas, Stefan & Hai

launches.body:
We’re building AI agents, inside a spreadsheet, that help sales teams find companies that already want to buy.\
\
The reality is most sales teams don’t struggle with effort - they struggle with timing.\
Reps spend huge amounts of time working static lists and broad targeting, chasing leads that were never going to convert. That creates noise, low reply rates, and wasted cycles.\
Top companies like Ramp solve this with dedicated growth engineers building internal data workflows.\
We’re making that same capability accessible to everyone else.\
\
At its core, the challenge is simple: \*\*finding customers who already have the problem you solve.\*\*\
Orange Slice turns the spreadsheet into a system for discovering buying signals - agents research company sites, news, social signals, and niche sources like court records or building permits, then structure that information directly into columns teams can act on.\
\
Not “might be a fit.”\
But “likely in-market.”\
\
So instead of guessing who to target, teams build and refine living lists of high-intent accounts inside a sheet.\
\
Still early. Still learning.\
But we’re excited to keep building.\
\
Kishan and I met sophomore year on a Bollywood dance team at Michigan — and I couldn’t ask for a better co-founder.\
\

launches.body:
**Hey there 👋 we’re Akshay and Andrés, and we’re building _item._**

Launch video: https://youtu.be/x8Z5QZNjdWw

\
**In a nutshell:**

_item_ is the first agentic CRM, a system that does the work. A system that understands your business the way your best employee does, and works for you 24/7.

If you’re building the future and still running on a 10-year-old CRM, let us show you what it feels like to run autonomously → [item.app](http://item.app)

**Meet Item**

_item_ connects to all your customer tools, gathers and enriches context automatically, and becomes your company’s **source of truth** — one place where your team and your AI agents share the full picture to act autonomously.

At the center is the _Assistant_ — your sidekick for daily work. It can send follow-ups, research leads, or add deals with a simple prompt. No complex UI, drop-downs or fields, simply ask.

For repeatable work, you build _Agents_ that you can train like new hires, simply by writing documents that describe your processes. item Agents run business processes across sales, support, and account management autonomously.

\
**The Status Quo**

AI has changed nearly every part of work. Yet the system at the center, the CRM, hasn’t evolved. It’s manual, data incomplete, and still takes trained experts to setup and automate.

We believe a CRM should know everything about your company and be able to do human-level work on your behalf, just like your best employee would.

\
**How it works:**

After a meeting, item helps you send a follow-up based on the notes in that meeting and your history with that customer:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95143&key=user_uploads/322839/38c59fd9-dc45-4ba6-a7db-69685a694356)

item searches the web to find information about any company or contact, allowing you to add deals with rich information without needing to enter fields yourself:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95143&key=user_uploads/322839/f34649f4-38aa-4731-9b80-d49b6d2edf0d)

You can build agents in item to automate any recurring human-level process by writing a simple, Notion-style document:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95143&key=user_uploads/322839/e61f581a-f4fa-402a-b16d-5955befb0a6e)

item gives you clean, context-rich contact and company profiles with table views and Kanban boards:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95143&key=user_uploads/322839/2607b996-e8bc-47b4-b861-0ce9c75293cf)

\
**How companies use item Agents today to run autonomously:**

* Outbound Sales: finding and contacting qualified leads on email and LinkedIn
* Inbound Management: qualifying and responding to leads that sign up to a waitlist or a self-serve product
* Growing Existing Accounts: tracking customer data and automatically sending personalized upsell sequences based on usage
* Keeping Pipeline Warm: setting up item to auto-update deals from emails and meetings

\
**The team**

We met at AngelList, building tools to help founders start and grow companies.

_item_ comes from that same spirit — built with care, designed with intention, and shaped by a decade spent building systems of record at places like SAP, IBM, and Follow-Up Boss.
